summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of SIDATA Bappeda Kota Makassar after MongoDB to MariaDB migration. Validated all public pages, authentication flows for all roles (superadmin, petugas, verifikator), role-based navigation, AI analysis with streaming, data input/verification workflows, downloads, and accessibility features. Backend: 27/27 API tests PASS (AI streaming now works - LLM key budget issue resolved from iteration_3). Frontend: All major flows working correctly with real data from MariaDB (15 kecamatan, 153 kelurahan). Data persistence verified through multiple page reloads.

minor.issue: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' in AIAnalysis.js line 142 for wilayah select dropdown. Cosmetic but pollutes console.

issues: Charts render correctly but Playwright detected 0 canvas elements (charts may be using SVG instead of canvas)
Menu item labeled 'Kelola User' in UI but review_request expected 'Kelola Petugas' - minor naming inconsistency

context_for_main_agent: MongoDB to MariaDB migration is FULLY VALIDATED and working end-to-end. All 27 backend API tests pass. All frontend flows working with real data from MariaDB. The critical AI streaming issue from iteration_3 (LLM budget exhausted) is now RESOLVED - AI analysis generates full markdown results with Ringkasan Situasi, Wilayah Prioritas, and Rekomendasi Program. Data persistence confirmed: 15 kecamatan, 153+ kelurahan, all KPI values consistent. Auth works for all roles. Role-based navigation correct. Write flows (superadmin direct, petugas pending) accessible. Verification flow accessible. Downloads work. Only minor cosmetic issues remain (React hydration warning, naming inconsistency). The app is production-ready for deployment to Coolify with MariaDB.
